resources.source_conflict: Primary paper Table 5 reports local interaction force constants (millidynes/angstrom): species FOUR, NH donor to hydroxyl O acceptor, 0.150; species FIVE, OH donor to N acceptor, 0.201. These are values for these particular reported conformers, not universal constants by interaction type. Supplement geometry pages 3-6 provide numbered atom identity diagrams and coordinate tables. Printed page 3 O...O=3.538 angstrom conflicts with its coordinate-derived O6-O14=2.538116731 angstrom. Printed page 4 O...O=2.787 angstrom agrees within 0.001 angstrom with coordinate-derived 2.786097706 angstrom. All four numbered diagrams and coordinate tables were visually checked. Coordinate scale is confirmed by comparison to the angstrom-labelled page 4 distance; page 3 inconsistent scalar is not used as a numeric answer.
